verdict.rationale: Claude is driven through the documented Claude API. It has an API overview with a playground and API keys, official SDKs in seven languages plus the ant CLI, a dated versioning policy with backward-compatibility guarantees, and a full API reference mirrored as .md and served through a docs MCP server. A community post about the Claude API's prefill feature corroborates hands-on use. Missing for 10: no evidence that consumer-app surfaces (Projects, memory, Cowork) are drivable through the public API beyond the Enterprise Compliance API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (the probe only checked the help-center domain).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: In the Console, you can use playground (platform.claude.com/playground) to try out the API in the browser and then generate API keys on the API keys page
Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries
Generally, if you are using the API as documented in this reference, Anthropic will not break your usage.
Compliance API: programmatically access Claude usage data including activity logs, chat histories, and file content
